I queried Cost Explorer for account 815362904471 over 2025-02-01 to 2025-03-01, but the result isn't scoped to that account. Its single entry is labelled account_id "org-wide", not 815362904471. The $61,842.55 total and its service split (EC2 compute $28,410.12, RDS $11,904.30, S3 $7,615.48, EKS $5,230.00, data transfer $4,800.00, CloudWatch $3,882.65) are the org-wide aggregate for February 2025 across all accounts.

That is the signature of the tool's historical-data fallback. For a window this old, Cost Explorer rejects the account-filtered query, and parsec retries without the account filter, collapsing the grouping to service. So the response can't tell you what 815362904471 itself spent, and I can't give you the account's February 2025 figure or its biggest service from it.

Please don't book $61,842.55 as the Halyard chargeback; that is the whole organisation's bill. For the account's own number, use the CUR / billing export for February 2025 filtered to 815362904471, or the payer's invoice line items for that linked account.
